commands.command: set -euo pipefail; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; git -C "$LA" fetch --quiet origin main; git -C "$LA" merge --ff-only origin/main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = '140f78d83f95dc2fde74bd3a69b7330d6b10803b'; python3 -c "import base64; exec(base64.b64decode(''))"; cd "$LA"; git diff --check; test "$(git diff --name-only | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md '; env -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_FDS -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_KEYS_DIGEST .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -q; git add -- README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md; git diff --cached --check; test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'README.md agent_version.py docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.11.4.md '; git commit -m 'Align downstream documentation for v4.11.4'; git push origin HEAD:main; SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | cut -f1)" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo CANDIDATE_SHA=$SHA
